name: mod.yagens_attributes.galvanized_chamber

capacity.description: Mod capacity used at level 0 and additional capacity per level. Total capacity cost is base + per_level * level.

max_level_description: Maximum inclusive Mod level. Level 0 is a usable Mod and every entry scales with (level + 1).

entries.description: Fractional additive bonus at level 0. A value of 1.0 means +100%; scales with (level + 1).
Fractional Addition per qualifying target status type or active qualifying-kill stack at level 0. Scales with (level + 1); duration_seconds and max_stacks do not scale with rank.

condition.description: Qualifying kills selected by trigger refresh all active stacks for duration_seconds, capped at max_stacks. Target status conditions count distinct independent proc types before this hit and ignore vanilla potion effects. Duration and stack cap are rank-independent.
